newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait oil firm says China deal worth $61.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait oil firm says China deal worth $61.5 mln.

text.p: Kuwait National Petroleum Company (KNPC) said on Sunday it had signed a $61.5 million deal with China Harbour Engineering Company, Kuwait News Agency said.
The value of the deal was not announced when it was signed last month.
The Chinese firm will enable KNPC's pier at Shuaiba refinery to handle four 100,000-tonne tankers at the same time, KUNA said.
KNPC has said that the deal was part of a plan to raise capacity at the refinery, damaged during the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation, by 50,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 200,000.
KNPC, the refining arm of state-owned oil conglomerate Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC), runs the Gulf state's three local refineries with a combined capacity of about 830,000 bpd.
Kuwait has a daily oil output of two million bpd.
